responsibility: Implements handling of Go `//go:embed` directives in the frontend, including parsing the build-system-supplied `embedcfg` JSON file, validating pattern-to-file mappings, reading embedded file contents, and constructing the corresponding frontend `Expression` trees for embedded strings, byte slices, and `embed.FS` values. It owns the embed configuration reader, file loading and size checks, and the synthesis of composite literals and heap/slice initialization used to materialize embedded data in the compiled package.
